## Purpose

The whole command-line surface of this crate is one file: `src/main.rs` declares `struct Cli` (a `clap` `Parser` holding a single `#[command(subcommand)]`), the `enum Command` with every verb as an inline struct variant, and the `main()` `match` that dispatches them. There is no `cli/` folder, no per-command module, and no builder-style command registry — a new verb is a variant plus an arm. Each arm is deliberately thin: it resolves the input, calls one pure function from a stage module (`digest::build`, `digest::query`, `facts::build`, `spec::compile`, `pagerank::rank`), serializes, and writes. All computation lives in the stage modules; `main.rs` owns argument shape, input resolution and output sink only. The payload is the contract: stdout is a machine surface, so an arm without `--out` prints the serialized document and nothing else.

## Convention

- Folder: `apps/scan/src/`, extension `.rs`, exactly one CLI file — `main.rs`. Today it carries `Cli`, `Command` (6 variants: `Scan`, `Digest`, `Facts`, `Spec`, `Rank`, `FeatureBundle`) and one borrowed output struct, `FeatureBundleOut<'a>`.
- Variant shape: first field is a positional `path: PathBuf` (a project dir **or** a prebuilt `grain.model.json`, resolved by the shared `load_model` helper); tuning knobs are `#[arg(long, default_value …)]` / `#[arg(long, default_value_t = …)]`; the last field is `#[arg(long)] out: Option<PathBuf>`.
- The `///` doc-comment on a variant IS the `--help` text and doubles as the design record — it states what the projection is for, what an empty result means, and which knob is fixed-point. Several paragraphs is normal here, not noise.
- Tuning values are integers, usually x1024 fixed point (`damping`, `hub_penalty`, `fanin_penalty`, `direct_base`) and a fixed iteration count — never a float knob and never a float convergence test, so two runs serialize identical bytes.
- Output sink is one fixed idiom per arm: `serde_json::to_string_pretty(...)`, then a `match out` that either writes the file and prints a one-line confirmation, or prints the JSON. Only `Scan` prints a human summary (`print_summary`), because it writes its product to disk rather than stdout.
- Comma/space-separated list flags are split inline with the same one-liner every arm uses (`split([',', ' '])` then trim then drop empties) rather than a custom parser type.
- Degraded inputs do not abort: the `Rank` arm reads the dictionary sidecar with `.ok().and_then(...)` and substitutes an empty one, and an unreadable model falls back to an empty `ProjectModel`, so the command still emits a well-formed document with an empty `files` list — the caller reads that as "nothing bridged". `FeatureBundle` applies the same rule to a missing sidecar by skipping the rank pool entirely.
- Guard that binds here too: nothing in `main.rs` may name a language, extension, grammar node or framework — help text included. Verbs and flags stay agnostic; the catalogs at the crate root hold that knowledge.

## How to apply

A new verb goes into `enum Command` in `apps/scan/src/main.rs`, in the same inline-struct form, with a `path: PathBuf` first and `out: Option<PathBuf>` last, and a doc-comment that explains the projection and its empty case. Add the matching arm to the `match cli.command` block and keep it to: `load_model(&path)?` (or the degradation path if the input may be absent), one call into the stage module, `to_string_pretty`, the sink. If the verb needs computation that does not exist yet, create or extend a module under `src/` and declare it in the `mod` list at the top of `main.rs` — do not grow the arm. If the payload combines several projections, declare a borrowed `#[derive(serde::Serialize)] struct <Verb>Out<'a>` next to `FeatureBundleOut` holding references so one model parse serves the whole bundle without cloning. Reuse the existing config struct when a verb replays another verb's computation (`FeatureBundle` builds a `pagerank::RankConfig` overriding only `top` and `direct_base_x1024`) so the two outputs stay byte-identical. Cover the verb end-to-end in `apps/scan/tests/<verb>_cli.rs`, spawning `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_scan")` over a minimal fixture and asserting the parsed JSON shape.
